name: MadKudu
summary: Predictive lead and account scoring (customer fit, behavioral engagement, lead grade), now sold by HG Insights, which acquired MadKudu in 2025; madkudu.com redirects to hginsights.com. For agents: a hosted MCP server whose docs put the API key in the URL path, and a REST API with an X-API-Key header. The vendor says very good leads convert about 10 times more than low ones and publishes no method or calibration.

payments.notes: API calls cost credits from an allowance that comes with an API access add-on (docs, read 2026-11-11): lookup 1, detailed info 3, AI web search 5. No plan price was read. The docs say to contact HG Insights for API access. Nothing prices a call in money.

agentAccess.notes: Docs: MCP URL is mcp.madkudu.com/<API key>/sse; REST takes X-API-Key, keys made by an admin. Keyless 2026-11-11: initialize and tools/list at mcp.madkudu.com/mcp answered 200 (14 tools, docs list 12); no tool was called. No OAuth metadata (404).

jobs.summary: Scores leads into fit segments (Very Good to Low), a behavioral score and a lead grade combining both. Vendor: very good leads usually convert about 10x more than low ones; no population or method. Top-decile lift and calibration unpublished; the product's performance page reports recall.
